profile.headline: AI Enablement + Agent Framework @ Airbnb
profile.summary: Staff software engineer at Airbnb, accelerating AI adoption in the product.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding member and technical lead for the AI Enablement team: accelerating the development and deployment of high quality AI/ML models and applications.

Creator and co-lead for Airbnb's Agent Framework: hosting production agentic applications that power the product.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding member and leader for new "AI Enablement" team, accelerating the development and deployment of high quality AI/ML models and applications.

Drove the design and implementation of CLI, SDK, and UI for Airbnb's in-house vector database.

Re-architected AI/ML workspaces platform with 1k monthly users, resulting in increased reliability and $1m/year cost savings.

Created alignment between infra, legal, privacy, and security teams captured in a new "Responsible Prototyping" policy which unlocked a surge of AI-related development and prototyping.

positions.title: Staff data scientist
positions.description:
Created Sandcastle, a web prototyping platform for AI/ML practitioners, with over 200 developers, 1000 apps and 2500 monthly active users.

Grew Onebrain, a data science microproject framework, from 10 to a thriving community of 500+ internal users.

Significantly contributed to alignment and development of an in-house AI/ML offline workflow orchestration engine.

positions.title: Principal data science manager
positions.description: Leading incubation of techniques and tooling around constrained ML; that is, machine learning in the presence of legal, privacy, and security constraints.

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist Manager
positions.description: Driving the modernization of Office AI workloads via migration to "compliant" Azure ML.

positions.title: Data Scientist 2
positions.description:
Spearheading the development of a cross-platform code-generation framework for creating trustworthy metrics computation code on a variety of big data platforms (Spark SQL, Azure Data Explorer, U-SQL, Spark).

Also working to improve the agility and trustworthiness of A/B testing in Bing.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Was "Czar's Assistant" for Calc 1 and 2—an administrative position that involves coordinating about 25 professors, graduate students, and undergraduate graders. Also assisted with the teaching of various classes, including Honors Calculus 2, Calculus 3, Complex Analysis, and graduate Algebra 1 and 2.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: Coordinated events, finances, and recruiting for an academic living center.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: Tutored undergraduates in calculus, differential equations, discrete math, and statistics.

honors.title: Eleanor Norton York Award
honors.description: Each year a student in the Mathematics Department and a student in the Astronomy Department, in which Eleanor York was employed, are selected to receive this award. The recipients are chosen from those in the middle of their graduate education on the basis of their achievements to date to encourage them to have even more success in the future. The York award is a monetary gift for approximately $500.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped build cottages for men trying to get off the street.

projects.title: Arizona Winter School
projects.description:
Collaborated to formulate a version of the Lang–Trotter conjecture for a new class of abelian 2-folds and tested the conjecture for large data sets.

Mastered concepts, ran simulations, and proved theorems in a high-intensity one week program.

Collaborated with a diverse team to develop and present new mathematics quickly.

projects.title: Flyxera
projects.description: Collaborated with two CS students at Cornell to create a location-centric cloud-based web service called Flyxera. The back-end was written in ASP.NET, using Ken Birman's library Vsync. We used Microsoft's Azure to host the service, and ran experiments to test scalability.

publications.title: Eval-driven development: Lessons from evaluating GenAI at scale
